reason: A workspace file browser and editor providing tree navigation, filename search, text reading and editing, file tabs, and system-default opening for registered workspaces.

summaries.zh: 在工作区中浏览目录、搜索文件，并通过标签页查看和编辑文本文件。
summaries.en: Browse workspace directories, search files, and view or edit text files in integrated tabs.

capabilities: Lists and searches files within registered workspaces
Reads text file contents and metadata
Writes edited file contents to workspace files
Opens files or directories with the system default program
Provides workspace file browser panels and editor tabs
